scope: Actual clear_v2 native before/after images and independently reimported Body-only GLB rendering, inspected visually.
colorTileOrigin: New AI-synthesized reference-inspired floral brocade; not an exact restoration of the source embroidery.
observedBodyImprovement: Selected Body cloth displays substantially sharper red, gold and dark floral motifs than the original blurred atlas. Physical long-axis tile length is 0.20m.
remainingNativeIssue: Large old-atlas triangles still interrupt the cloth. Actual ray casts show the sampled interruptions belong to Lion_Body_Red_Trim, which this Body-only prototype intentionally leaves unchanged. The existing Trim classification includes flat cloth patches.
glbObserved: New floral motif remains visible after actual standard GLB reimport. Body-only export has gaps where separate Trim geometry was omitted by design; this is a material/UV export test, not a complete lion scene.
normalComparisonObserved: At a real 0.06m horizontal macro width, strengths 0, 0.18 and 0.25 show very subtle differences under this studio lighting. The 2048 tangent normal is embedded, imported as Non-Color, and connected through NormalMap with UV1. The motif color itself already depicts fine woven linework; no claim of photometric thread reconstruction is made.
nextRequiredWork: Correct verified flat cloth patches misclassified into Trim, then inspect complete combined native and exported scenes. Exact original embroidery and seam-free reconstruction are not demonstrated.
